summary: Final pointer cleanup on two registered questions whose discriminators still described steps their accounts had already measured. The empty-configuration admission question now points at what is genuinely open there — whether the same admissions occur when the restarted node shares a cluster with a legitimate peer holding the correct configuration, since every measurement used single-node clusters. The verification question now points at whether any other consumer of peer acknowledgements over-counts non-voters, since the leader lease was measured to count voters only and the verification path is the one that does not. No evidence, comparison or conclusion changed; the run closes with eight measured questions, ten behavior entries, one answered gap, and each account stating its counterevidence and limits.
